history.summary: An uncompleted (TOP ~2029) 1,206 sqft 4BR at Bloomsbury Residences in the one-north/Mediapolis district, $3.0M / $2,488 PSF — slightly under the $2,573 launch median but with no realised appreciation, a poor 1.6km MRT walk, a high $3M quantum, and the lowest technical score in the batch (475). The one-north innovation-hub thesis is real, but the entry combines several investment drags.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $2,488 is ~3% under the $2,573 incoming median (which itself is launch pricing, not proven resale gains) — no margin of safety. Appreciation is null (new launch, bias-flagged), so there is no URA track record to lean on. The unit is uncompleted (TOP ~2029, no income/exit for years), $3M sits above the deep-liquidity band for a 4BR, and the nearest MRT is 1.6km / 19-min walk — weak for D05. The one-north employment catalyst and low score_1000 (475) roughly offset to a cautious Neutral.
